Djokovic won the last 3 sets 6-3 6-2 6-4, making Zverev look like one dimensional chump. It's simply further validation of Djokovic's incredible slam level in 2025, not far from his 21-23 level, which was enough to convincingly beat a multi-slam winner. It's just too bad it wasn't enough to beat ATGs.
